definition: Timothy Wilking Finin (born August 4, 1949) is an Emeritus Professor in the Computer Science and Electrical Engineering department and director of the Center for Artificial Intelligence at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC).
details: His research has focused on the applications of artificial intelligence to problems in information systems and has included contributions to natural language processing, expert systems, the theory and applications of multiagent systems, the semantic web, and mobile computing.

explainer.lead: Tim Finin is an American computer scientist. His work spans artificial intelligence, semantic Web, natural language processing and knowledge-based system.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Knowledge Query and Manipulation Language, Swoogle and Why we twitter: understanding microblogging usage and communities.

contributions.name: He is the author of more than 500 refereed publications and has received research grants and contracts from a variety of sources.

timeline.what: Bachelor of Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
Researcher at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (until 1974)
Doctor of Philosophy, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
Assistant professor at University of Pennsylvania (until 1987)
Professor at University of Maryland, Baltimore County (until 2025)
